entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected.
Connecting you to the returns department now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to return something. I think. It's all very confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller. The order number is... um... VF-8675309. I have these cycling shoes, and I just don't think they're right.

Okay, Sarah, I have your order pulled up. I see the Road Cycling Shoes, delivered about 30 days ago. To make sure I get you to the right solution, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

I... I don't know. They just hurt. I tried adjusting the cleats like the website said, but I can't get it right and they gave me terrible blisters on my heel. The sizing guide was so complicated. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for you. Let me just take a look at our policy for this item.
Okay... I just hope it's not too late.

Not at all. I see here that for standard items like these cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window. Since you received them 30 days ago, you're well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

No worries at all. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 10 minutes. Also, because you're a VIP member with us, I'm going to waive the standard return fee and I've added a $20 credit to your account for the inconvenience. We'd love for you to find a pair that's a perfect fit.
Wow, a credit too? Thank you so much, Alex! That is incredibly helpful. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome, Sarah. We appreciate your business. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and we hope to see you back at VeloFit soon.
